title: questlog roadmap.json
description: Project meta + quests + milestones + items + assets. Source of truth for a project's roadmap. Frozen against Build Plan Section 1.2.

id.description: Lowercase id, prefix by type. Unique within its file.

dispatchId.description: Batch-dispatch id (disp-…). Ties a consumed founder note / unclear flag to the one 'Send to agent' press that dispatched it.

evidenceEntry.description: ONE observation that something was CLAIMED about this milestone — by whom, when, about which run. It never asserts the claim is TRUE. Append-only; the idempotency key is (source, ref, kind), so a watcher restart re-observing the same journal writes nothing.

source.description: Which observer wrote this. Automation may write evidence; automation may NEVER write status.

kind.description: launch = a run began. finish = a run claimed completion. verdict = a ship/no-ship call (carries ship). abandon = the run was dropped. retract = a tombstone over one earlier entry by the SAME source (never a deletion).

ref.description: The run identity: a workflow id (wf_…), a dispatchId, or a sidecar log stamp.

claim.description: What the writer asserts, verbatim, never interpreted. <= 500 chars.

ship.description: REQUIRED when kind is verdict, FORBIDDEN otherwise. true = this run's verdict was ship; false = no-ship (refutes any earlier finish at or before this ts).

sessionId.description: OPTIONAL session that produced the observation.

tombstonesRef.description: REQUIRED when kind is retract, FORBIDDEN otherwise. The key of the entry being tombstoned, as "<source>|<ref>|<kind>".

parentMilestoneId.description: null for main quest; REQUIRED milestone id for side quests (the branch point).

side.description: null for main; left|right for side quests.

plain.description: OPTIONAL plain-register restatement of the quest's meaning. Absent = old behavior. Titles never swap; this feeds the Plain English toggle only where descriptive text is shown.

statusReason.description: REQUIRED non-empty when status is blocked.

plain.description: OPTIONAL plain-register restatement of title+summary. Feeds the Plain English toggle (swaps the summary slot).

unclear.description: OPTIONAL. true = founder flagged this milestone as unclear. Absent or false = not flagged.

unclearAt.description: OPTIONAL. REQUIRED valid timestamp when unclear===true; null/absent otherwise (enforced by validate.mjs).

unclearDispatchId.description: OPTIONAL. Set (with unclearDispatchedAt) when a dispatch consumes this standing unclear flag; both-or-neither.

unclearDispatchedAt.description: OPTIONAL. ISO timestamp the flag was dispatched; both-or-neither with unclearDispatchId.

evidence.description: OPTIONAL, additive, append-only. Observations that runs were launched / claimed finished / judged / abandoned against this milestone. Absent = old behavior (a road with no evidence reads exactly as before). claimsComplete is DERIVED from this array at read time and is NEVER stored.

blockedReason.description: REQUIRED non-empty when status is blocked.

pending.description: OPTIONAL. true = a founder note awaiting a dispatch (set only by POST /api/note). Absent or false = not pending. Cleared to false when a dispatch consumes it.

dispatchId.description: OPTIONAL. Set (with dispatchedAt) when a dispatch consumes this note; both-or-neither.

dispatchedAt.description: OPTIONAL. ISO timestamp the note was dispatched; both-or-neither with dispatchId.

plain.description: OPTIONAL plain-register restatement of the item body. Feeds the Plain English toggle (swaps the body slot).

unclear.description: OPTIONAL. true = founder flagged this item as unclear. Absent or false = not flagged.

unclearAt.description: OPTIONAL. REQUIRED valid timestamp when unclear===true; null/absent otherwise (enforced by validate.mjs).

unclearDispatchId.description: OPTIONAL. Set (with unclearDispatchedAt) when a dispatch consumes this standing unclear flag; both-or-neither.

unclearDispatchedAt.description: OPTIONAL. ISO timestamp the flag was dispatched; both-or-neither with unclearDispatchId.
